requirement.statement: The system SHALL expose AI workflow profile descriptors that explicitly bind AI Ctrl Workflow to WorkCtrlFlow and AI Data Workflow to EagerDataFlow.

case.given: An AI Ctrl Workflow descriptor is inspected
case.then: The descriptor SHALL identify WorkCtrlFlow as the substrate

case.given: An AI Data Workflow descriptor is inspected
case.then: The descriptor SHALL identify EagerDataFlow as the substrate

requirement.statement: The system SHALL model global roots, workspace roots, state stores and AI effect providers as injected runtime/config contracts.

case.given: A foundation helper creates an AI workflow runtime context
case.then: The helper SHALL preserve those roots without constructing host-specific paths

case.given: An AI workflow node requires an AI effect
case.when: The node invokes the provider through runtime
case.then: The system SHALL use the injected provider interface instead of an external CLI boundary

requirement.statement: The system SHALL define node-level reuse policy vocabulary with semantic-hash as the default machine node policy and never as the default manual node policy.

case.given: A non-manual AI workflow node has no explicit reuse policy
case.when: The platform resolves the effective policy

case.given: A manual AI workflow node has no explicit reuse policy
case.when: The platform resolves the effective policy
